tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Once a day, check one Polish contractor (one NIP) in public registries. The check reads VAT status and white-list bank accounts from the Ministry of Finance, and reads KRS for liquidation, bankruptcy or restructuring. tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List contractors monitored for your account, with the last stored status and recent change events. Reads only this server's database. Requires sign-in (OAuth) or an almmity API key.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Remove one contractor, identified by NIP, from monitoring for your account. Deletes the watch and stops future alerts. Requires sign-in (OAuth) or an almmity API key.

tools.name: payment_audit_report
tools.description: Before paying a Polish contractor, verify the NIP and bank account on the MF VAT white list for the payment date, check KRS and VIES, and store a PDF proof of due diligence (MF request IDs, timestamps, findings, SHA-256). tools.name: check_vat_whitelist
tools.description: Query the Ministry of Finance VAT white list (wl-api.mf.gov.pl). Returns the full taxpayer card: name, NIP, VAT status, REGON, KRS, address, every account (groups of 4), registration/denial/removal/restoration dates with legal basis, representatives, authorized clerks, partners, virtual accounts, an

tools.name: get_krs_extract
tools.description: Current KRS (National Court Register) extract: name, legal form, address, share capital, board and representation, proxies, PKD codes, liquidation and bankruptcy flags. Reads a public registry and does not change it. Callable without an API key, within the daily per-IP limit.

tools.name: find_company
tools.description: Combine the MF VAT white list and KRS into one normalized company profile. Provide one of nip, regon or krs. Reads public registries and does not change them. Callable without an API key, within the daily per-IP limit.

tools.name: vies_check
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number via the European Commission VIES REST API, for example PL7740001454 or DE811569869. Reads a public registry and does not change it. Callable without an API key, within the daily per-IP limit.

tools.name: contractor_due_diligence
tools.description: Concise risk summary for a Polish contractor by NIP: VAT status, whitelisted accounts (optionally verify one bank account), and KRS liquidation, bankruptcy or restructuring flags. Reads public registries and does not change them. Callable without an API key, within the daily per-IP limit.

tools.name: validate_ksef_xml
tools.description: Validate a KSeF FA(3) invoice XML against the official Ministry of Finance schema (when xmllint and the vendored XSD are available) and against business rules: NIP checksum, totals, bank account checksum, required JST/GV, correction references. Returns Polish error messages. Does not send the invoic

tools.name: generate_fa3_xml
tools.description: Build a sales invoice XML in the FA(3) schema (kodSystemowy FA (3), variant 3) from seller, buyer and line items. Header VAT is computed from the summed net base of each rate. Does not send the invoice to KSeF and does not store it. Callable without an API key.

tools.name: generate_correction_xml
tools.description: Build an FA(3) correction invoice (RodzajFaktury KOR). Header amounts are the difference versus the original. Pass beforeLines to emit state-before (StanPrzed) and state-after rows; otherwise lines are the delta. Does not send the invoice to KSeF. Callable without an API key.

tools.name: summarize_ksef_invoice
tools.description: Parse an FA(3) XML into a short Polish summary: parties, dates, net, VAT, gross, split payment, due date and bank account. Returns a link to the XML-to-PDF viewer. It creates a temporary PDF file on api.almmity.com, reachable by an unguessable link for one hour, then deleted. Nothing is sent to KSeF

tools.name: build_transfer_title
tools.description: Build a Polish bank transfer title that carries one KSeF invoice number or a collective identifier (art. 108g VAT). mode=mpp builds the split-payment message /VAT/IDC/INV/TXT and checks the supplier NIP checksum. Does not send a payment. Callable without an API key.

tools.name: calculate_late_interest
tools.description: Calculate Polish late-payment interest with the same rates and day count as ksef.almmity.com: commercial (NBP reference + 10 pp), medical public debtor (+ 8 pp) or statutory (reference + 5.5 pp), plus the 40/70/100 EUR compensation converted at the NBP euro rate. tools.name: draft_payment_demand
tools.description: Draft a Polish pre-court payment demand (wezwanie do zapłaty) from the same interest calculation as calculate_late_interest, including art. 187 of the Code of Civil Procedure. Returns the text. It creates a temporary PDF file on api.almmity.com, reachable by an unguessable link for one hour, then de

tools.name: nip_checksum
tools.description: Check the checksum of a Polish NIP (weights 6,5,7,2,3,4,5,6,7). Local arithmetic only. Callable without an API key. Does not look the NIP up in any registry.

tools.name: list_cost_invoices
tools.description: List cost invoices already stored on the linked KSeF Płatności account: number, seller, amounts, due date, payment status and white-list check. Requires OAuth scope invoices.read. Never ask the user for a KSeF token or a password. Does not download new invoices from KSeF.

tools.name: unpaid_due_soon
tools.description: List unpaid cost invoices on the linked KSeF Płatności account that are overdue or due within withinDays (default 7, max 90). Requires OAuth scope invoices.read. Never ask for a KSeF token or a password.

tools.name: export_transfer_batch
tools.description: Prepare an Elixir-0 transfer file for selected cost invoices on the linked KSeF Płatności account. Each account is re-checked on the MF white list for today; unsafe lines are left out of the file. Requires OAuth scope transfers.prepare. The file is not sent to a bank.
